cwe_content.cwe: CWE-89,Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')

candidate.Code:
def update_profile(self, profileid, field):
        with Transaction(self.conn) as tx:
            q = "UPDATE users SET \"%s\" = ? WHERE profileid = ?"
            tx.nonquery(q % field[0], (field[1], profileid))
candidate.Reason: The function directly interpolates user-supplied input (field[0]) into an SQL query without proper sanitization, making it vulnerable to SQL injection attacks. An attacker could manipulate the field parameter to inject malicious SQL commands.
